publication_status: Published profile — taxonomy qualifications in notes
host_note: Murayama (1925b:232) reported Quercus glauca and Q. gilva from Japan, not Taiwan. Beaver & Shih (2003) noted that original Taiwan specimen documentation was uncertain.
taxonomy_summary: Crossotarsus simplex Murayama, 1925. Source-specific taxonomic history and uncertainties follow.

taxonomic_history.name: Crossotarsus simplex
taxonomic_history.note: Original 1925:231–232 checked. Taiwan checklist notes no actual original Taiwan specimens located; Japanese host observations are direct original evidence.

nomenclature_note: The original description was verified in Murayama (1925b:231–232). Beaver & Shih (2003) questioned the earlier Taiwan specimen documentation.
